build_mega_model: build a MEGA encoder-decoder model instance from args and task using MegaModel.build_model
run_mega_encoder_forward: run the MEGA encoder forward pass on source tokens with padding mask and chunking support
run_mega_decoder_forward: run the MEGA decoder forward pass with encoder output and incremental state for autoregressive decoding
extract_decoder_features: extract decoder features from the MEGA decoder without applying the output projection layer
configure_mega_architecture: configure a MEGA model architecture with encoder decoder dimensions dropout and normalization settings
